headline: Contract with Shawmut Design and Construction for Pawtucket High School, plus fencing, roof, and hot water tank projects at several schools.
summary: Items include a food service update from Aramark, a discussion of the absentee rate for Local 1352, and a plan for classroom staffing coverage. A closed session on a District employee's job performance, school security, and a union grievance may also be held.
items: Public participation comments
Special reports from student representatives at Charles E. Shea High School, William E. Tolman High School, and Jacqueline M. Walsh School for Performing and Visual Arts
Approval of Girl’s Flag Football Sports Program
Approval of updated organizational chart
Recommendation to approve master planner
Recommendation to approve OPM Stage II submission
Homeschool list addendum approval
Second passage of revision of Policy BEDB
Guaranteed Maximum Price agreement with Shawmut Design and Construction for Pawtucket High School
Cunningham Elementary School playground fencing and gate installation
Jenks Middle School domestic hot water tank replacement
Nathanael Greene Elementary School Pre-K playground fencing installation
Greene roof proposal
Food service program update from Aramark
Absentee rate for Local 1352
Staffing coverage plan for classrooms
Committee member community updates
Subcommittee updates for building, facilities, finance, policy, and wellness
Reports on budget transfers, departmental overtime, enrollment, monthly distribution, vacancies, and work orders
Possible closed session on job performance of a District employee, security, and a grievance hearing under a collective bargaining agreement
Return to open session and reporting of any votes subject to disclosure
location: Jenks Junior High School, 350 Division Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
